text.p: Following are the main stories in Tuesday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The Chief Minister of Selangor state who was arrested by Brisbane airport customs last week for failing to declare 2.4 million ringgit ($6 million), explained that he was carrying the money to buy property in Australia for his family.
- Malaysian auto maker Perusahaan Otomobil Nasional Bhd (Proton) rolled out its one millionth car, and unveiled a new coupe model.
- Twenty-seven people were injured when the bus they were travelling in plunged down a ravine four kilometres from the Genting Highlands resort outside Kuala Lumpur

- Mitsubishi Corp. the Japanese car maker which helped start Malaysia's national car project in 1985, can now help the (local) car industry to become more competitive, said Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad at the roll-out of the one millionth Proton on Tuesday.
